title: TechFuelHQ Community Coil Whine Census — submission row
description: One row = one physical unit the submitter owns (GPU, PSU, or AIO pump), scored on the anchored 0-4 severity scale at its loudest normal state. The dataset publishes per-model DISTRIBUTIONS (n + share of reports at each severity), never per-model verdicts, because coil whine varies unit to unit within the same model. CC BY 4.0.

component_type.description: The component the report is about.

brand.description: Brand as printed on the box, e.g. 'ASUS', 'Corsair', 'Arctic'.

model.description: Model line, specific enough to group units for a distribution, e.g. 'ROG Strix RTX 4090', 'RM850x (2021)', 'Liquid Freezer II 280'.

exact_sku.description: OPTIONAL. Exact manufacturer SKU when known, e.g. 'ROG-STRIX-RTX4090-O24G-GAMING'. Empty string when unknown.

purchase_year.description: Year the unit was purchased. Must not be in the future; the validator enforces <= the current year.

severity.description: Anchored severity at the unit's loudest normal state: 0 = inaudible in a quiet room; 1 = audible ear-at-case; 2 = audible at desk under load; 3 = audible across room under load; 4 = audible idle.

load_context.description: The load state in which the reported severity was observed (the state that produced the score).

psu_used.description: OPTIONAL. For GPU reports: the power supply feeding the system, e.g. 'Corsair RM1000x' — whine sometimes moves with the PSU. Empty string when unknown or not applicable.

fps_cap_changes_it.description: OPTIONAL. true if capping the frame rate (V-Sync / FPS limiter) audibly changes the whine; false if tested and it does not; empty when untested. CSV encoding: 'true', 'false', or empty string.

notes.description: OPTIONAL. Free text, max 280 characters — what it sounds like, whether it faded over the first weeks, what quieted it.

submitted_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the report was submitted. For issue-form reports the maintainer uses the issue's creation date. Must not be in the future.

publication_rules.activation_floor: per-model n + severity distribution once a model has >=5 reports; below that the model is listed as collecting, with no verdict
publication_rules.self_selection_bias: Annoyed owners over-report and silent units under-report, so published whine percentages are ceilings, not unbiased estimates.
